claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with current settings (CMV/ASSIST/AutoFlow, PEEP 13 cmH2O, FiO2 50%, set rate 22), monitoring peak/plateau pressures and tidal volumes.
Continue the insulin infusion and titrate to maintain glucose in target range, with frequent fingerstick glucose monitoring.
Obtain arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation given prior respiratory acidosis and hypercapnia.
Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and lactate to assess resolution of anion gap metabolic acidosis.
Continue sedation with midazolam and fentanyl infusions, titrating to Richmond RASS target and monitoring depth of sedation.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (vancomycin, cefepime, azithromycin) and reassess response with cultures and clinical status.
Perform chest imaging to evaluate pulmonary infiltrates and ventilator mechanics given sputum specimen and elevated airway pressures.
Continue corticosteroid therapy with methylprednisolone and monitor for hyperglycemia and infection.
Replete potassium cautiously given prior hypokalemia and current whole-blood potassium 4.9 mEq/L, with repeat electrolyte monitoring.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin and monitor for bleeding.
